Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Quality Goods
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PiXQFmP.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿﻿
First add-on mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23386]Yet Another (Balanced) Quality Goods Mod[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but made to match with it.

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.

[center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dIibzU8.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23386]Yet Another (Balanced) Quality Goods Mod[/url]﻿.﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTUL7Ne.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
